variants.title: Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations in graphene
variants.sample: Graphene, n = 1e16 per m^2, cyclotron mass about 0.02 m_e (SIMULATED)
variants.method: R_xx against 1/B at 1.5 K, amplitude against T at 2 T
variants.unknown: carrier density from the period, effective mass, quantum lifetime
variants.note: Fourfold degeneracy: n = 4 e F/h. The cyclotron mass of massless Dirac carriers is hbar kF/vF (about 0.02 m_e at this density). Density, mass and lifetime are illustrative.

source.title: K. S. Novoselov et al., Nature 438, 197 (2005)
source.note: the density, mass and lifetime are illustrative

variants.title: Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations in bismuth
variants.sample: Bismuth single crystal, field along the trigonal axis (hole pocket) (SIMULATED)
variants.method: R_xx against 1/B at 1.5 K, amplitude against T at 3 T
variants.note: A 3D semimetal: F is the extremal cross-section of the hole pocket, A = 2 pi e F/hbar, not a sheet density; only the fundamental of one pocket is modelled. The mass comes from the temperature dependence. F about 6.3 T and m* about 0.064 m_e are quoted from memory - verify.

source.title: D. Shoenberg, Magnetic Oscillations in Metals (Cambridge, 1984): bismuth
